title: 6 Claude Commands That Rewire How You Think 🧠 (Ranked)
tags: claude code,slash commands,custom commands,claude commands,ai thinking partner,premortem,steelman,claude ai tips,ai for beginners,prompt engineering,ai productivity,ai tips
lines: You use Claude for answers. So does everyone. That's the mistake.
Six commands make it think WITH you. Build each once, one file. Watch.
Six. Steelman builds the strongest case FOR your idea, before you fall for it.
Five. E-L-I-five re-explains your plan simply. The fuzzy part is where you're bluffing.
Four. Scout maps what you need to know before you commit.
Three. Devil argues against you, hard, using your own logic.
Two. Blindspots names what you can't see.
One. Premortem assumes you already failed, and tells you exactly why. This one rewired how I plan.
Stop asking Claude for answers. Make it argue with you.
Follow. I unpack one AI trick every single day.
